query: Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 release specs price dual 3D V-Cache
answer: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition processor has an MSRP of $899 according to multiple sources. It features 16 cores and threads, a base clock of 4.3 GHz, and a maximum boost clock of 5.6 GHz. The processor has a total cache of 208 MB, a TDP of 200W, and runs on the AM5 platform with Zen 5 architecture. Prices vary internationally, with listings on Amazon showing a price of JPY 140,845, and discussions on YouTube suggesting a street price of £830, though AMD's PR agency reached out with a price of £799.99.

results.title: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition review: Tons of cache for tons of dollars - Ars Technica
results.content:
To recap, it’s a version of the existing 16-core Ryzen 9 9950X3D (MSRP $699, street price around $660) where both of the processor’s 8-core Zen 5 CPU chiplets have 64MB of extra L3 cache stacked beneath them. Normally, one of the chiplets has extra cache and one does not. This gives the CPU a whopping 208MB of cache, a number that is very large. But you don’t need a large CPU review to understand the differences between this chip and the regular 9950X3D that we reviewed over a year ago. [...] # AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition review: Tons of cache for tons of dollars
